author: mmdyzy - Apeng-Who-Doesn-t-Want-a-Name
description:
Bedrock-style touch, UM edition
Original author: Nameless Apeng
Edition author/maintainer: mmdyzy

The FCL built-in layout was updated together in 1.8.60 and 1.8.61, so both changelogs are included

Changelog (1.8.61):
HUD and F3 buttons on the quick panel now close the panel when tapped
Fixed the control mode page not being able to close
Adjusted some text layout
Fixed the missing gray mask at the top/bottom of the international-style chat screen
Fixed two slashes appearing in commands when tapping the two top buttons of the command input bar
The chat screen no longer shows inventory function keys
TouchController mode: double-tapping the screen center no longer middle-click picks
Added email contact in Layout Info
Fixed mod layout keys interfering with each other

Changelog (1.8.60):
Removed the "Debug" button in the "Game" tab
Dead zone is shown when pressed
Added quick perspective switch button
Long-pressing the drop key now quickly drops items
All mouse keys at the bottom-right no longer block camera rotation
Double-tapping the crosshair now middle-click picks
NetEase mode: "Widget Guide" button changed to "Quick Phrase", and the two right-side buttons removed
Removed ads
Removed flashlight button
Moved the macro-hold key to make it harder to mis-tap
Adjusted the mouse key layout to feel more like a real mouse
The C-key zoom button can no longer be hidden individually
You are now asked to pick a control mode when loading the layout
Control mode can no longer be changed anytime
Control mode background changed to fully transparent
